inputs.original_text: Look at the exact wording they are feeding us: it's right there in the open, disguised as a 2026 State of the State agenda. They are pushing proposed legislation to force gun manufacturers in New York to alter how firearms are designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns, all while setting up new criminal penalties. But anyone with half an eye open sees the real agenda behind this coordinated maneuver by the elites. This isn't about public safety; it's a calculated, systemic stripping of defense capabilities under the guise of technical regulations. They control the narrative, they dictate the design, and then they criminalize dissent. It's a complete inversion of reality, designed to disarm the populace while the hidden architects tighten their grip.
